_comment: Letters that come to the player (Mail.java). In mail.msg.* lines (what's written or passed on) {player} is what they call you, {town} a town, {what} what it's about (a quest done, a festival, a warning), {dead} who died, {owed} a sum, {when} how soon. In the rest {player} is what it calls you, {who} who it's from, {what} the words to pass on.

any: i keep thinking about you {what}. thank you, truly. if you're ever in {town}, there's a place at our fire.
just wanted to say it again: thank you for {what}. people here still talk about it.
{player}, i never thanked you properly for {what}. so: thank you. come by {town} sometime.
come and see me in {town} when you can. i've work for someone i can trust, and it pays.
{player}, i need someone i can rely on. come to {town}. ask for me.
there's something i'd rather ask you than anyone else. come to {town} when you're able.
we know what you did. we haven't forgotten. watch yourself.
you think nobody saw? someone did. sleep lightly.
this isn't over. not by a long way.
i had to warn you: {what}. be careful, please.
listen. {what}. keep your head down for a while.
{player}, word reached me: {what}. don't go thinking you're safe.
i'm sorry to be the one to tell you. {dead} is gone. they spoke of you often.
bad news, i'm afraid. {dead} died. we buried them outside the town. i know you two were close.
{dead} is dead. i thought you'd want to hear it from a friend, not from a stranger.
it's {what} in {town} {when}. come! it won't be the same without you.
{what} is {when}, here in {town}. there'll be food and music. come if you can.
we're having {what} {when}. you'd better be there, {player}.
you still owe {town} a fine of {owed}. pay it to a guard, or don't come back.
a reminder: {owed}, owed to {town}. we haven't forgotten.
{owed}. that's what you owe {town}. pay up.
it's been ages. we miss you in {town}. come back and see us.
{player}, where have you got to? it's quiet here without you. come by {town}.
haven't seen you in so long. i hope you're alright. write back, or better, come.
hey {player}! something came for you
{player}! wait up, ive got something for you
oi {player}, a letter came
{player}! ive got news for you
hey {player}, hold on. someone asked me to tell you something
a letter came for you, from {who}
here. from {who}
this is for you. {who} sent it
here, i wrote you this
i wrote this for you. read it later
take this. its from me
{who} asked me to tell you: {what}
word from {who}: {what}
